# `browser-extension/services/ImageGenerationContract.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/ImageGenerationContract.js`

Provider-neutral, fail-closed image-generation contract. Image input and chat capability metadata never enters this contract. A provider is admitted only when this reviewed table names an exact image endpoint, or when OpenRouter's dedicated image-model catalog returns an exact `output_modalities: ["image"]` record for the requested model.

## Functions

### `imageGenerationProviderAdapter(provider)`

### `imageGenerationTransportEvidence(value = null)`

Project only affirmative, versioned image-generation transport evidence. Chat connectivity, image input, a provider name, or a connected Companion never authorizes image-output discovery by itself.
